audit.why: TRICKY / 6/10 fits 48.64% over 294 games and a chart where Sion holds 1-5 and 2+ items while Yi owns 6 and first item.
audit.corrected: Left at TRICKY, 6/10; the quoted '~45% WR' corrected to 48.6%.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game reversal is attributed to 'stacked armor eating your shred', and R is called a global engage.
audit.why: Soul Furnace grants Sion permanent max-health on kills and Glory in Death gives a healing second life — health and the revive are what outlast you, not armour alone, since Wuju Style's bonus damage is true. Unstoppable Onslaught is a 7500-range steered charge on 140/100/60s, not global.
audit.corrected: Late reversal reframed around health stacking, the zombie passive and the R charge's real range and cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Passive shield' appears in whys[0], spikes[0].text, early and wants.foe[1]. Three interactions are absent.
audit.why: Sion's passive is Glory in Death (a zombie second life whose rapid attacks HEAL him and deal max-health damage). The shield is Soul Furnace (W), 11-15s. Absent from the page: Decimating Smash and Unstoppable Onslaught both cancel Meditate's channel; Glory in Death's healing makes Grievous Wounds decide extended fights; Roar of the Slayer shreds your armour on a 8-12s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Shield attributed to Soul Furnace (W); passive named as Glory in Death with its healing; Meditate cancel and Grievous Wounds stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers on the key cooldown.
audit.why: Decimating Smash is 10/9/8/7/6s — the whole lane is played around it.

edits.before: Sion's charged Q stun and passive shield crush your level 1 trades.
edits.after: Sion's charged Decimating Smash (Q) crushes your level 1 trades.

edits.before: At 2+ items his stacked armor and R engage out-tank your shred.
edits.after: At 2+ items his health stacking and second life outlast you.

edits.before: Sion controls levels 1-4: a charged Decimating Smash (Q) one-shots your trade attempts and stuns you out of Alpha Strike, while his passive shield and Roar of the Slayer (E) shove you off farm. Never stand still near a charging Q; use Alpha Strike only to dodge it, not to trade into it.
edits.after: Sion controls levels 1-4: a fully charged Decimating Smash (Q) knocks you up on a 10s cooldown and cancels a Meditate channel outright, while Soul Furnace (W) shields him and Roar of the Slayer (E) shreds your armour off the wave. Save Alpha Strike to dodge the swing, never to trade into it.

edits.before: With a first item you still out-damage Sion in a clean duel, but the moment he goes full tank his Q stun plus Unstoppable Onslaught (R) knockup let him disengage or flip a fight. Kill him before his armor spikes; after that it's a shove-and-roam lane.
edits.after: With a first item you still out-damage Sion in a clean duel, but Unstoppable Onslaught (R) drops to 60s at rank 3 and charges you down from up to 7500 units for a knockup that flips the fight. Kill him before his health stacks; after that, shove and roam.

edits.before: Late Sion out-tanks your shred once he's stacked armor and his global R engage makes chasing him risky, so the cell tips back to him; play around Highlander resets in teamfights rather than dueling his front line.
edits.after: Late Sion out-tanks you once he has stacked health, and Glory in Death (P) hands him a second life whose attacks heal him - bring Grievous Wounds. His R charge makes chasing risky, so play Highlander resets in fights, not duels.

edits.before: Sion owns the first four levels: a fully charged Decimating Smash (Q) stuns and nearly deletes your early trades, and his passive shield plus Roar of the Slayer (E) push you off the wave. Farm respectfully and save Alpha Strike (Q) to dodge his charge, never to trade into it.
edits.after: Sion owns the first four levels: a fully charged Decimating Smash (Q) knocks you up and nearly deletes your early trades, and Soul Furnace (W) shields him while Roar of the Slayer (E) shreds your armour and pushes you off the wave. Save Alpha Strike to dodge the swing.

edits.before: Once Sion completes tank items and his R engage is up, the matchup swings back to him at 2+ items because his stacked armor eats your shred and his global knockup flips fights, so rely on Highlander resets in teamfights rather than dueling him.
edits.after: Once Sion completes tank items the matchup swings back at 2+ items: armour blunts your on-hit even though Wuju Style (E) stays true, and his 7500-range R charge flips fights, so rely on Highlander resets in teamfights rather than dueling him.

edits.before: Shove with E and passive shield to deny your farm
edits.after: Shove with E and Soul Furnace (W) to deny your farm

edits.before: Track Decimating Smash (Q) — the fully-charged knockup is his only hard CC and his only reliable burst; when it's down, you can step up and trade or all-in, and when it's up, you respect Alpha-Strike-dodge range or back off.
edits.after: Track Decimating Smash (Q) — 10s at rank 1 down to 6s, and the fully-charged knockup is his only hard CC and his only reliable burst; with it down you step up and trade or all-in, with it up you hold Alpha Strike as the dodge or back off.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetability can dodge his fully-charged Decimating Smash knockup; Wuju Style true damage ignores the armor his Roar of the Slayer and tank items stack; Meditate out-sustains his Soul Furnace chip; Highlander's slow immunity ignores any slow attached to his engage.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetability can dodge his fully-charged Decimating Smash knockup; Wuju Style's true damage cuts through the armour his tank items stack; his Q and his R both cancel a Meditate channel outright, so sustain out of their range; and Glory in Death's zombie attacks heal him, so Grievous Wounds decides whether the second life matters.

edits.before: TRICKY (~45% WR): Sion edges a losing early and reclaims the full-tank late, but a disciplined Yi who farms to his on-hit spike owns level 6 and the first-item window — patience wins this lane, aggression loses it.
edits.after: TRICKY (48.6% WR): Sion edges a losing early and reclaims the full-tank late, but a disciplined Yi who farms to his on-hit spike owns level 6 and the first-item window — patience wins this lane, aggression loses it.

notes: Sion's passive is Glory in Death (zombie second life, healing attacks), not a shield — the shield is Soul Furnace (W). The page called it 'passive shield' in four places. Unstoppable Onslaught was called global; it is a 7500-range steered charge. Level chart matches the packet, so no chart edits. Kept the armour claim honest: Wuju Style's bonus is true damage, but your on-hit basic damage is still reduced by armour, so I wrote 'blunts' rather than either extreme.
